limit = self.custom.table.limit or 500
	pages = []	
	numPages = (len(value['chkShtEventInfo']) / limit)
	
	for i in range(numPages):
		item = value['chkShtEventInfo'][i*limit]
		fromDate = item['takenDate'] or item['scheduledDate']
		item = value['chkShtEventInfo'][(i*limit)+1]
		toDate = item['takenDate'] or item['scheduledDate']			
		pages.append({'fromDate': fromDate, 'toDate': toDate})
	
	pages.sort()
	return {'numPages': numPages, 'pages': pages}

onChange.script:
def buildColumn(field, title, justify, sortable, hdrStyle, width, viewPath, viewParams, visible, bgColor):
	
		rowStyle = ({'backgroundColor' : bgColor, 'fontSize' : '10px','borderRightWidth' : '1px' , 'borderRightStyle' : 'solid','borderRightColor':'#C1C1C1', 'height': '40px'})
	
		return {
				  "field": field,
				  "visible": visible,
				  "editable": False,
				  "render": "auto",
				  "justify": justify,
				  "align": "center",
				  "resizable": True,
				  "sortable": sortable,
				  "sort": "none",
				  "filter": {"enabled": False, "visible": "on-hover", "string": {"condition": "", "value": "" }, "number": {"condition": "", "value": ""}, "boolean": {"condition": ""}, "date": {"condition": "", "value": ""}},
				  "viewPath": viewPath,
				  "viewParams": viewParams,
				  "boolean": "checkbox",
				  "number": "value",
				  "progressBar": {"max": 100, "min": 0, "bar": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "track": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "value": {"enabled": True, "format": "0,0.##", "justify": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}}},
				  "toggleSwitch": {"color": {"selected": "", "unselected": ""}},
				  "NoneFormat": {"includeNoneStrings": False, "strict": False, "NoneFormatValue": ""},
				  "numberFormat": "0,0.##",
				  "dateFormat": "MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm",
				  "width": width,
				  "strictWidth": True,
				  "style": rowStyle,
				  "header": {"title": title, "justify": justify, "align": "center", "style": hdrStyle},
				  "footer": {"title": "", "justify": "left", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "" }}
				}

#	system.perspective.print("updateCols() called")

	colInfo = self.custom.updateColumns
	if not colInfo.has_key('columns'): return
	if not colInfo.has_key('startingCol'): return
	if not colInfo.has_key('numOfCols'): return	
	if colInfo.startingCol is None: return
	if colInfo.numOfCols is None: return
	if colInfo.columns is None: return

	blue = '--kcBlue-10'
	green = '--kcGreen-10'
	orange = '--kcOrange-10'
	gray = '--kcGray-10'
	if 'dark' in self.session.props.theme:
		blue = '--kcBlue-80'
		green = '--kcGreen-80'
		orange = '--kcOrange-80'
		gray = '--kcGray-80'

	hdrStyle = {'backgroundColor' : gray, 'fontWeight': 'bold', 'fontSize' : '12px', 'borderBottomWidth' : '1px' , 'borderBottomStyle' : 'solid','borderBottomColor':'#D5D5D5'}
	colHeader = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(self.view.custom.table.data)
	displaySettings = self.custom.updateColumns.displaySettings
			

	cols = [
				{'colName':'chkItemId', 'title':'chkItemId', 'sortable': True, 'justify': 'center', 'width':450, 'viewPath': 'kanoa/qds/analysis/tableGroupLabel', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': False, 'backgroundColor' : ''},
				{'colName':'chkItemName', 'title':'Check', 'sortable': True, 'justify': 'center', 'width':450, 'viewPath': 'kanoa/qds/analysis/tableGroupLabel', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showCheckItemPath else False, 'backgroundColor' : blue},
				{'colName':'chkItemPath', 'title':'Check', 'sortable': True, 'justify': 'center', 'width':320, 'viewPath': 'kanoa/qds/analysis/tableGroupLabel', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': False if displaySettings.showCheckItemPath else True, 'backgroundColor' : blue},
				{'colName':'engUnitName','title':'Units', 'sortable': True, 'width':60, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showItemInfo else False, 'backgroundColor' : blue},
				{'colName':'points','title':'Trend', 'sortable': False, 'width':120, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': 'kanoa/qds/analysis/charts/sparkline', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True,'backgroundColor' : blue},
				{'colName':'Alert','title':'Alert', 'sortable': False, 'width':60, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': 'kanoa/qds/analysis/tableCellIcon', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True, 'backgroundColor' : blue},
				{'colName':'summaryMin','title':'Min', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSummary else False, 'backgroundColor' : green},
				{'colName':'summaryMax','title':'Max', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSummary else False, 'backgroundColor' : green},
				{'colName':'summaryAvg','title': 'Average', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSummary else False, 'backgroundColor' : green},
				{'colName':'summaryStdDev','title':'Std Dev', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSummary else False, 'backgroundColor' : green},
				{'colName':'Calc. LCL','title':'Calc. LCL', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSummary else False, 'backgroundColor' : green},
				{'colName':'Calc. UCL','title':'Calc. UCL', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSummary else False, 'backgroundColor' : green},
				{'colName':'summarySum','title':'Sum', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSummary else False, 'backgroundColor' : green},
				{'colName':'lsl','title':'LSL', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSpec else False, 'backgroundColor' : orange},
				{'colName':'lcl','title':'LCL', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSpec else False, 'backgroundColor' : orange},
				{'colName':'tgt','title':'Target', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSpec else False, 'backgroundColor' : orange},
				{'colName':'ucl','title':'UCL', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSpec else False, 'backgroundColor' : orange},
				{'colName':'usl','title':'USL', 'sortable': True, 'width':80, 'justify': 'center', 'viewPath': '', 'viewParams': {}, 'visible': True if displaySettings.showSpec else False, 'backgroundColor' : orange},
			]

	colHeader += ['Min', 'Max', 'Average', 'Std Dev', 'Calc. LCL', 'Calc. UCL', 'Sum', 'Alert', 'points']

	fixedColumns = []
	for item in cols:
		if item['colName'] in colHeader:
			fixedColumns.append(buildColumn(item['colName'], item['title'], item['justify'], item['sortable'], hdrStyle, item['width'], item['viewPath'],  item['viewParams'], item['visible'], item['backgroundColor']))

#	fixedColumns = [buildColumn(item['colName'], item['title'], item['justify'], True, hdrStyle, item['width'], item['viewPath'],  item['viewParams'], item['visible'], item['backgroundColor']) for item in cols if item['colName'] in colHeader]

	self.view.custom.table.columns.fixedColLength = len([i for i in fixedColumns if i['visible']])
	self.props.columns = list(fixedColumns) +  colInfo.columns[colInfo.startingCol:colInfo.startingCol + colInfo.numOfCols]

#	system.perspective.print("Building Fixed columns ended")

	return

transforms.code:
def getChkShtColName(chkShtEventId):
		for item in value['chkShtEventInfo']:
			if item['chkShtEventId'] == int(chkShtEventId.replace('chkShtEventId_','')): return system.date.format(item['takenDate'] or item['scheduledDate'], 'MM-dd-yy HH:mm')
		return str(chkShtEventId)

	def buildColumn(field, title, justify, sortable, hdrStyle, rowStyle, visible):
		return {
				  "field": field,
				  "visible": visible,
				  "editable": False,
				  "render": "auto",
				  "justify": justify,
				  "align": "center",
				  "resizable": True,
				  "sortable": sortable,
				  "sort": "none",
				  "filter": {"enabled": False, "visible": "on-hover", "string": {"condition": "", "value": "" }, "number": {"condition": "", "value": ""}, "boolean": {"condition": ""}, "date": {"condition": "", "value": ""}},
				  "viewPath": "",
				  "viewParams": {},
				  "boolean": "checkbox",
				  "number": "value",
				  "progressBar": {"max": 100, "min": 0, "bar": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "track": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "value": {"enabled": True, "format": "0,0.##", "justify": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}}},
				  "toggleSwitch": {"color": {"selected": "", "unselected": ""}},
				  "NoneFormat": {"includeNoneStrings": False, "strict": False, "NoneFormatValue": ""},
				  "numberFormat": "0,0.##",
				  "dateFormat": "MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm",
				  "width": 80,
				  "strictWidth": True,
				  "style": rowStyle,
				  "header": {"title": title, "justify": justify, "align": "center", "style": hdrStyle},
				  "footer": {"title": "", "justify": "left", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "" }}
				}

	hdrStyle = {'backgroundColor' : '--kcPrimaryContainer', 'fontWeight': 'bold', 'fontSize' : '10px', 'borderBottomWidth' : '1px' , 'borderBottomStyle' : 'solid','borderBottomColor':'#D5D5D5'}

	colHeader = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(value['data'])
	colHeader = [hdr for hdr in colHeader if 'chkShtEventId_' in hdr]	

	rowStyle = ({'fontSize' : '10px','borderRightWidth' : '1px' , 'borderRightStyle' : 'solid','borderRightColor':'#C1C1C1'})
	return [buildColumn(colName, getChkShtColName(colName), 'center', False, hdrStyle, rowStyle, True) for colName in colHeader]	#This list is ordered by the items sort order

minStartCol = 0 								#this is our min value for 0%
	maxStartCol = len(value.cols) - value.numCols	#this should be our max value for 100%
	increment = (maxStartCol - minStartCol) / 100.0

 	splitPosition = int(value.splitPercent.replace('%',''))
	return int(splitPosition * increment)

def getChkShtInfo(chkShtEventId):
		for item in value['chkShtEventInfo']:
			if item['chkShtEventId'] == chkShtEventId: return item
		return None
	
	def buildFootCol(title, span, justify, fontWeight):
		return {"title": title, "span": span, "justify": justify, "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", 'padding':'5px', 'backgroundColor':'--kcGray-10', 'fontWeight': fontWeight}}

	if not value.displaySettings.showFooter: return []

	resourceFooterItems = ['Item', 'Asset', 'Shift', 'Taken By'] if value.displaySettings.showFooter else []
	statusFooterItems = ['Failed Checks'] if value.displaySettings.showFooter else []
	
	footerItems = resourceFooterItems + statusFooterItems
	fixedColLength = self.view.custom.table.columns.fixedColLength
	footers = [[buildFootCol(footerItems[y], fixedColLength, 'right', 'bold') for i in range(len(value.cols))] for y in range(len(footerItems))]

	data = value['data']
	if len(data) == 0: return []
	
	footerCols = []
	for col in value['cols']:
		if 'chkShtEventId_' not in col.field: continue		
		footerCols.append(col['field'])

	for i, col in enumerate(footerCols):
		chkShtInfo = getChkShtInfo(int(col.replace('chkShtEventId_','')))
		
		y = 0
		if len(resourceFooterItems) > 0:
			footers[y][i+1] = buildFootCol(chkShtInfo['itemName'], 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+1][i+1] = buildFootCol(chkShtInfo['assetPath'].replace('\\', ' > '), 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+2][i+1] = buildFootCol(chkShtInfo['shiftName'], 1, 'right', 'normal')
			footers[y+3][i+1] = buildFootCol(chkShtInfo['submittedByUser'], 1, 'right', 'normal')
			y = 4

		if len(statusFooterItems) > 0:	footers[y][i+1] = buildFootCol(chkShtInfo['failedChecks'], 1, 'right', 'normal')

	return footers
